meta.name: issue-tracking
meta.description: Manage tasks, epics, and bugs based on ISSUE_TRACKING environment variable. Use `env-get` to determine storage (fs or github) and tools.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理任务、史诗和缺陷，自动适配本地或GitHub存储
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同存储间无缝管理项目任务。
copy.tagline_en: Manage tasks, epics, and bugs with automatic storage adaptation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage project tasks across different storage backends.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据环境变量自动选择本地文件或 GitHub 来管理任务、史诗和缺陷。它会用 Gherkin 格式描述功能，并用表情符号前缀区分层级。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、查看或更新任务、史诗或缺陷时触发。Claude 会先读取 ISSUE_TRACKING 环境变量以确定存储方式。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新任务，描述为“用户登录功能”。
列出所有未关闭的史诗。
say.note: Claude 会调用 issue-list 工具并过滤类型。

say.text: 把这个 bug 标记为已修复。
say.note: Claude 会更新对应 issue 的状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude manages tasks, epics, and bugs based on the ISSUE_TRACKING environment variable, using local files or GitHub. It formats features in Gherkin and prefixes titles with emoticons for hierarchy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create, view, or update tasks, epics, or bugs. Claude first reads the ISSUE_TRACKING variable to determine the storage backend.

say_en.text: Create a new task for the user login feature.
say_en.note: Claude will create an issue using the template and auto-add YAML frontmatter.
Claude will call issue-list and filter by type.
Claude will update the issue status.
